verdict.rationale: Missive exposes a REST API, webhooks, and a hosted MCP server with OAuth-scoped access to conversations, contacts, calendars, and drafts (read/write/send), giving strong programmatic coverage of core mail/CRM actions [missive-docs-31, missive-docs-15, missive-probe-rt-2]. However there's no public OpenAPI/swagger spec (404s) and no evidence that other prominent UI features—automation rules, canned responses/templates, snoozing, team-space management—are exposed via the API, so full UI-API parity is unconfirmed. Missing for 10: OpenAPI/full endpoint reference, API coverage of rules/canned responses/snoozing/team administration, and independent confirmation of parity.
